```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# 设置报告运行环境，并加载流程共用函数。
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# 从 Rmd 文件位置或工作目录定位 pipeline 根（兼容 render 与交互运行，不依赖 .git/.Rproj）。
input_dir <- tryCatch(
  dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), mustWork = FALSE)),
  error = function(e) ""
)
root_candidates <- unique(normalizePath(
  c(input_dir, getwd(), file.path(getwd(), "snRNAseq_publication_pipeline")),
  mustWork = FALSE
))
pipeline_root <- root_candidates[
  file.exists(file.path(root_candidates, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
][1]
if (is.na(pipeline_root)) {
  stop("Cannot locate the pipeline root containing R/pipeline_helpers.R", call. = FALSE)
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = pipeline_root)
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
```

## Configuration

```{r libraries}
# 从集中参数文件读取 marker panel。
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "config", "pipeline_params.R"))

# 检查并加载 marker 验证和绘图所需包。
check_packages(c("Seurat", "SeuratObject", "Matrix", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "here"))

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

paths <- get_pipeline_paths(project_root = dirname(pipeline_root))
fig_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$fig_dir, "03_Manual_Marker_Validation"))
table_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$table_dir, "03_Manual_Marker_Validation"))
```

## Load annotated tissue objects

```{r load}
# 读取 01/02 步骤输出的最终注释对象。
sc_spleen <- readRDS(file.path(paths$rds_dir, "01_spleen_annotated.rds"))
sc_bm <- readRDS(file.path(paths$rds_dir, "02_bonemarrow_annotated.rds"))
```

## Marker panels

```{r marker_panels}
# 脾脏和骨髓的复核 marker panel 统一由 config/pipeline_params.R 定义
# （spleen_validation_markers / bm_validation_markers）。
```

## Spleen validation

```{r spleen_validation, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}
# 按最终 CellType_Fine 分组验证脾脏 marker 表达。
p_spleen_dot <- make_marker_dotplot(
  sc_spleen,
  spleen_validation_markers,
  group.by = "CellType_Fine",
  title = "Spleen manual marker validation"
)
print(p_spleen_dot)
save_pub_plot(p_spleen_dot, "03_spleen_fine_label_marker_dotplot", fig_dir, width = 13, height = 8)

spleen_validation <- marker_validation_table(sc_spleen, spleen_validation_markers, group_col = "CellType_Fine")
write.csv(spleen_validation, file.path(table_dir, "03_spleen_marker_validation_by_fine_label.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 输出每只 mouse 的脾脏 fine label 细胞数。
spleen_label_counts <- sc_spleen@meta.data |>
  count(Group, MouseID, CellType_Fine, name = "Cells")
write.csv(spleen_label_counts, file.path(table_dir, "03_spleen_fine_label_counts_by_mouse.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Bone marrow validation

```{r bm_validation, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}
# 按最终 CellType_Fine 分组验证骨髓 marker 表达。
p_bm_dot <- make_marker_dotplot(
  sc_bm,
  bm_validation_markers,
  group.by = "CellType_Fine",
  title = "Bone marrow manual marker validation"
)
print(p_bm_dot)
save_pub_plot(p_bm_dot, "03_bm_fine_label_marker_dotplot", fig_dir, width = 13, height = 8)

bm_validation <- marker_validation_table(sc_bm, bm_validation_markers, group_col = "CellType_Fine")
write.csv(bm_validation, file.path(table_dir, "03_bm_marker_validation_by_fine_label.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 输出每只 mouse 的骨髓 fine label 细胞数。
bm_label_counts <- sc_bm@meta.data |>
  count(Group, MouseID, CellType_Fine, name = "Cells")
write.csv(bm_label_counts, file.path(table_dir, "03_bm_fine_label_counts_by_mouse.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Manual review sheets

```{r review_sheets}
# 收集所有手动注释 map，生成一个便于人工复核的汇总表。
map_files <- c(
  Spleen_B_cells = file.path(paths$map_dir, "spleen_bcell_manual_map.csv"),
  Spleen_T_cells = file.path(paths$map_dir, "spleen_tcell_manual_map.csv"),
  BoneMarrow_B_lineage = file.path(paths$map_dir, "bm_blineage_manual_map.csv")
)

review_sheet <- bind_rows(lapply(names(map_files), function(panel) {
  x <- read.csv(map_files[[panel]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  x$Panel <- panel
  x
}))

write.csv(review_sheet, file.path(table_dir, "03_manual_annotation_review_sheet.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
review_sheet
```
